title: Theft vs. Robbery vs. Burglary
summary: Force turns theft into robbery; entry with criminal purpose is burglary.

rows.label: Force or threat
cells: Injury, force, or threat of immediate injury during the theft or immediate flight

rows.label: Entry into a structure
cells: Required, with purpose to commit an offense inside

rows.label: Must something be taken?
cells: No, an attempted theft is enough
No, the purpose at entry is enough

tip: A shoplifter who shoves a guard on the way out can be charged with robbery: force during the immediate flight counts.
note: Plain-language summary. Not yet verified against official sources. Read the full statute before charging.
